# Existing .pert plans should normally be maintained through perttool commands; direct DSL editing bypasses goal/DAG owner-confirmation checks.
project V3_STAGE_TRIAL:
  version 5
  title "First two-character V3 Stage battle trial"
  description "Current owner policy: unreleased production/Stage shared environment; first Google-owner V3 game use. Requirements v3 supersede first-trial legacy compatibility/history preservation, email and backup/restore gates. Preserve new V3 correctness and owner authentication. vt104 minimal deployment/detail candidate -> vt105 deployment -> vt106 authoring and vt108 old unfinished disposal -> vt107 observed game. Remaining internal estimates vt1040.25-0.75h, Stage1.5-4.25h low; external waits separate. Actual local tests retained without claiming Stage pass. Existing measured velocity25p/17h is one declared elapsed sample, not person effort. docs/character-v3-battle-cutover-requirements-v3.md; owner unreleased shared-environment policy and plan correction 2026-09-30; docs/evidence/vt104-unreleased-trial-rescope-2026-09-30.md"
  as_of 2026-09-29
  duration_unit point
  velocity 25p/17h
  finish VST_PLAYED
  goal_owner user
  dag_owner user

milestone VST_LOCAL_CANDIDATES:
  title "Two local V3 candidate fixtures exist"
  description "Neva and Rio deterministic V3 content originated on codex/v3-stage-trial-candidate at 77ed6a0 and was integrated into cc304 for vt101. Exact owner content acceptance and Stage registration remain separate."
  state reached

  title "Developer"

  description "Exact candidate review and owner confirmation bind receipts and content digest; immutable append and CAS activation with rollback and readback work through the SQLite/PostgreSQL repository contract. Neva and Rio fixed candidates can exercise the same path locally; real Stage activation belongs to vt106."
  state reached

  title "Immutable V3 battle lifecycle and local cutover verified"

milestone VST_WIRED:

milestone VST_LOCAL_BATTLE:

  title "Trial release is deployed to Stage and read back"

milestone VST_STAGE_READY:

milestone VST_PLAYED:
  title "Owner has tried a real V3-versus-V3 Stage battle"

task vt101 VST_LOCAL_CANDIDATES -> VST_LOCAL_FIXTURE:
  title "Verify local direct registration and selection of V3 trial fixtures"
  description "Correction on 2026-09-29: completed scope is the SQLite-only direct importer and fixture selection checks at 0585527. Preserve historical events as recorded partial intervals. The original accepted candidate-review/owner-confirm/activation obligation is carried by vt109; original 2/3/4p remains historical and is not a new completed-throughput observation."
  estimate:
    optimistic 2p
    most_likely 3p
    pessimistic 4p
  status done
  requires:
    DEV 1
  source "docs/evidence/vt101-local-v3-registration-2026-09-29.md; plan revision 13 completion correction"

task vt102 VST_LOCAL_CANDIDATES -> VST_REVISION_BOUND:
  title "Bind V3 revisions through all real battle consumers"
  description "Complete immutable V3-by-V3 binding, exact generation IDs/digests/compiler inputs and combat snapshots through HTTP, SSE, action, state replay, narration and worker consumers. Preserve historical 3/4/5p and recorded start value 4p. Reconcile historical WIP with the exact accepted successor contract. Centralized lifecycle/cutover expansion is separately vt110; full integration requires both. Resume requires parent cm305 acceptance handoff in vt111; historical suspended start source is retained because perttool requires it already reached."
  estimate:
    optimistic 3p
    most_likely 4p
    pessimistic 5p
  status done
  requires:
    DEV 1
  source "Owner immutable revision decisions; exact successor contract via VST_CONTRACT_READY. Historical estimate retained for original binding/consumer slice; expanded lifecycle/cutover is vt110."

gate vg101 VST_CURRENT -> VST_WIRED:
  reason "Local integration needs registered, selectable V3 characters"

gate vg102 VST_BOUND -> VST_WIRED:
  reason "Local integration needs immutable V3 battle binding and consumers"

task vt103 VST_WIRED -> VST_LOCAL_BATTLE:
  title "Complete one local Neva-versus-Rio battle end to end"
  description "Exercise Neva and Rio through registration, selection, V3-by-V3 creation, execution, reload and visible result on the real local path. Verify V2-by-V2 and mixed new creation are rejected; both immutable revisions remain bound after editing; cutover deletes only pre-cutover unfinished fixtures and invalidates HTTP/state replay and worker continuation while finished history stays readable. Record exact IDs and evidence."
  estimate:
    optimistic 1p
    most_likely 2p
    pessimistic 3p
  status done
  requires:
    DEV 1
  source "Owner decision: try V3 characters in a real Stage battle; local integration prerequisite"

task vt104 VST_LOCAL_BATTLE -> VST_RELEASE:
  title "Prepare the minimal unreleased V3 trial candidate"
  description "Accepted design v1 option1 local workflow/validator/testing complete. Frozen local source563 paths; current source needs authorized synchronization and exact hosted tag/prepare artifact. Remaining exact execution packet: live writer/queue/DB/backlog, required migration names and numeric secret versions, Google redirect and paid budget readbacks. No email/snapshot/legacy compatibility/public promotion prerequisites. Residual internal effort0.25-0.75 agent h low; local success is not deployed game evidence."
  duration 1p
  status suspended

    DEV 1
  source "docs/unreleased-v3-trial-design-v1.md; docs/evidence/vt104-execution-candidate-2026-10-01.md; docs/evidence/vt104-unreleased-trial-source-2026-10-01.json"

Determine old writer/queue coordination from new battle correctness, without legacy availability, snapshot restore or production-promotion proof as trial acceptance."

    most_likely 1p
    pessimistic 2p

  requires:

  estimate:

  source "docs/character-v3-battle-cutover-requirements-v3.md; owner unreleased shared-environment policy and plan correction 2026-09-30; docs/evidence/vt104-unreleased-trial-rescope-2026-09-30.md"

  description "Retain the already chosen pre-cutover unfinished disposal target. Backup, restore R and finished-history compatibility are not blockers. No blanket DB/user/history reset is authorized."
  estimate:
    optimistic 0.25p
    most_likely 0.5p
    pessimistic 1p
  requires:
    DEV 1
  source "docs/character-v3-battle-cutover-requirements-v3.md; owner unreleased shared-environment policy and plan correction 2026-09-30; docs/evidence/vt104-unreleased-trial-rescope-2026-09-30.md"

task vt109 VST_LOCAL_FIXTURE -> VST_CURRENT:
  title "Complete V3 candidate review, confirmation and activation"
  description "Fulfil the original remaining vt101 accepted authoring obligation: persist exact fixed Neva/Rio V3 candidates in the reusable authoring path, expose review, accept the reviewed candidate and receipts, append immutable generations and CAS activate, and read/select through common SQLite/PostgreSQL contracts. Test decline, duplicate confirmation, drift/conflict, rollback and readback. Local tests use a synthetic owner; exact Stage owner/data actions remain vt106. Provider generation and broad three-mode evaluation stay downstream. Provisional 1/2/4p reflects reuse of existing authoring lifecycle plus V3 type/activation/read-contract work; re-estimate after first complete candidate-confirmation test."
  estimate:
    optimistic 1p
    most_likely 2p
    pessimistic 4p
  status done
  requires:
    DEV 1
  source "Accepted character-v3-authoring-requirements-v5 R18; ADR-0010/0014. Existing implementation authority; independent of proposed battle cutover ADR-0039."

task vt110 VST_REVISION_BOUND -> VST_BOUND:
  title "Centralize V3 battle eligibility and physical cutover"
  description "Complete the expanded lifecycle/cutover obligation: share V3-only participation eligibility across owner selection, opponent/random/auto pools and direct create API; centralize create/read/advance/replay/discard; physically delete old unfinished battles and related continuation data; prevent deterministic recreation and late worker/save effects while retaining finished history. Verify SQLite/PostgreSQL storage contracts. Provisional 0.5/1/2p assumes reuse of vt102 adapters and transactions; update at the first deletion/replay test. Stage execution is vt108."
  estimate:
    optimistic 0.5p
    most_likely 1p
    pessimistic 2p
  status done
  requires:
    DEV 1
  source "Owner approved narrow lifecycle and physical deletion; exact successor ADR/design prerequisite; plan revision 13"
